verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a consumer authenticator and password manager, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows any MCP server. A runtime probe found that its llms.txt declares 'Public API: None' with no agent-callable endpoint. Its agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, markdown mirrors) are adjacent documentation features, not an MCP integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
